test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Plausible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**plausible**" means something that is reasonable or believable based on available information or evidence. (सत्य प्रतीत होने वाला)

 
 
• **For example**: *Her excuse for being late seemed plausible because of the heavy traffic.*
